extracted_definitions.term: University of Southern California / Van Nuys Prognostic index (USC/VNPI)
extracted_definitions.definition: A prognostic index that stratifies patients into high, intermediate, or low risk based on age, tumor grade, tumor size, and margin from resection
extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: Use of adjuvant Tamoxifen and Radiotherapy (after lumpectomy) is guided by the University of Southern California / Van Nuys Prognostic index (USC/VNPI). This stratifies a patient into high (10-12), intermediate (7-9) or low risk (4-6) based on the criteria which individually scores as 1, 2 or 3 as described below:
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: The USC/VNPI is a widely used prognostic index that can be applied across different specialties and settings.

extracted_definitions.definition: The status of estrogen and progesterone receptors in the tumor
extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: Estrogen or Progesterone receptor status of primary or recurrent tumour or metastatic sites
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: ER/PR status is a widely used biomarker that can be applied across different specialties and settings.

extracted_definitions.definition: The level of expression of the HER2 protein in the tumor
extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: HER-2 expression in primary or recurrent tumor or metastatic sites
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: HER2 expression is a widely used biomarker that can be applied across different specialties and settings.

extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: Whole breast reconstruction (WBR) with or without nipple areolar reconstruction should be offered to motivated young women who have to undergo a mastectomy
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: This term is specific to the surgery specialty and is not a general medical concept.

extracted_definitions.definition: reconstruction of a part of the breast
extracted_definitions.source_excerpt: Partial breast reconstruction (PBR): Is indicated after upfront surgery for large tumor with micro-calcification or after NACT with unfavourable breast to tumor ratio and patient is keen on breast conservation.
extracted_definitions.scope_rationale: This term is specific to the surgery specialty and is not a general medical concept.

extracted_rules.description: Indication for adjuvant radiotherapy after BCT
extracted_rules.source_excerpt: Post-operative RT is required after BCT in women at higher risk of recurrence as described below.
extracted_rules.scope_rationale: The indication for adjuvant radiotherapy is specific to the surgery specialty and depends on the risk of recurrence.

extracted_rules.condition_hint: tumor size, multicentric disease, diffuse micro-calcification
extracted_rules.source_excerpt: The breast conservation approach would be considered successful if it produces satisfactory cosmetic outcome and the probability of tumor control or late sequelae are not inferior to mastectomy.
extracted_rules.scope_rationale: The eligibility for BCT is specific to the surgery specialty and depends on the tumor characteristics.

extracted_rules.description: Offer breast reconstruction to women who are likely to have a poor cosmetic outcome after BCT or are undergoing mastectomy
extracted_rules.condition_hint: poor cosmetic outcome after BCT or undergoing mastectomy
extracted_rules.source_excerpt: Breast reconstruction: In centres with such expertise, breast reconstruction should be offered to women who are likely to have a poor cosmetic outcome after BCT or are undergoing mastectomy and not at excessive risk of local recurrence or wound complication.
extracted_rules.scope_rationale: This rule is specific to the surgery specialty and is not a general medical concept.
